title: This Website
blurb: The site you're on right now — a vintage, film-inspired portfolio built on Next.js 15. Every section carries a metaphor: a projector reel for experience, a record crate for projects, a 35mm strip for photos, and a paper notebook for writing.

title: IT Homelab
blurb: A hands-on IT infrastructure lab built to sharpen sysadmin skills: Windows Server 2025 with Active Directory deployed on Microsoft Azure, plus Linux server administration — documented project by project.

title: NOSO Labs
blurb: A call analysis dashboard for service teams: AssemblyAI transcribes the call, the OpenAI API scores compliance and surfaces sales insights, and a synchronized audio player pairs with a speaker color-coded transcript view.

title: MDB iOS Training
blurb: Exercises and builds from Mobile Developers of Berkeley's iOS training track — the reps behind the polished apps.

title: iMDB
blurb: A movie review app built with MDB (hence the name) — browse titles, write reviews, and rate films from your pocket, with reviews synced through Firebase.

title: JMG WorkScape
blurb: A contractor invoicing, client management, and job navigation iOS app built in SwiftUI — featuring a custom Trie-based client lookup that made address search 90% faster and cut scheduling overhead for field contractors.
